name: LiveJasmin
summary: Long-running luxury cam network emphasizing studio-lit HD streams, strict model presentation standards, and one-on-one per-minute private shows.
ranking_rationale: Unmatched lighting, camera polish, and curated private-show quality, but explicit action sits behind pricey per-minute billing rather than open public rooms.

pricing.free_tier: Public teaser chat lobbies before entering paid private rooms
pricing.notes: Per-minute private rates vary by model; credit bundles vary by package. Check official checkout.

pros: Consistently high HD video, lighting, and audio standards
Curated, polished feel ideal for one-on-one private sessions
Established platform operating for over two decades
cons: Public chat is non-explicit; explicit shows require paid privates
Per-minute credit burn can add up quickly
Feels more corporate and studio-managed than indie token sites

facts.value: Launched 2001; operated by Docler Holding / Byborg Enterprises
Teaser public chat with credit-billed per-minute private shows
Strict HD broadcast quality and polished private one-on-one shows
